title: Special Topics in Latin American and Caribbean Studies; Tropical Dreams: Nature and Art in Brazil
description:
Cross-listed with LASC448Y, PORT408A, SPAN408O and SPAN609A. Credit only granted for PORT408A, LASC448Y, LASC648Y, SPAN408O, or SPAN609A.

This course explores how representations of nature in Brazilian literature and visual arts have informed constructions of nationhood as well as the critiques of the country's complex history of colonialism, exploitation, and inequality. Taught in English.
